item.title: MUNDO, where students learn about the world by experiencing it
item.description: A student-led initiative called MUNDO has built a community for students to learn more about culture, identity and social issues from hands-on experiences, rather than lectures in a classroom. item.title: How athletes’ sleep data applies to the average student
item.description: Athletes make deliberate decisions throughout the day to maintain peak health, including sleep. When athletes function with little to no sleep, tiredness and brain fog are common side effects, but can also result in long-term performance — and a pair of Ohio State researchers say the same applies to students.
